text:
zoe: quick flag 1 nightly run produced 11 medium + 1 high (auth-redirect). Compliance asked for an auditable auto-escalation + removal plan for long-lived SA keys on scanner runners. Thoughts?

pete: agree. Minimal flow: 1) GH Action (GitHub App) writes immutable audit event; 2) action writes signed pointer (sha256) to encrypted audit-bucket; 3) if decrypt needed, request ephemeral decrypt token from kms-proxy; 4) staged escalation: 24h assign+comment, 48h digest to oncall, immediate page only for P0/P1.

maya: kms-proxy must require evidence pointer + reviewer binding before issuing token. Deny tokens when automation path triggers a page. Proxy should log: actor, pr, key_id, key_version, ttl. Example call: `curl -X POST https://kms-proxy.internal/issue -H "Authorization: Bearer $WORKLOAD_JWT" -d '{"key":"scan-keys/repokey","pr":5301209876,"ttl":300}'`

sec-bot: [scan-run] nightly/5301209876: 11 medium, 1 high. report: https://scans.internal/5301209876

oncall-sre: please bundle alerts. we want an aggregated digest with list+sev+owner+repro pointer and a runbook link. page immediately only for P0/P1. digest cadence configurable (24h/48h). include revoke steps.

zoe: compliance retention: audit events + signed pointers = 36 months. raw artifacts need exception request. we should add an attestation entry to the PR when evidence is archived.

infra: RBAC change plan: rotate SA keys -> add workload identity + GitHub App assume role. we'll make migration GH Action to swap secrets and mark deprecated keys.

pete: GH Action sketch (runs-as App): `# 1) write audit event -> POST $AUDIT/events 2) call scanner -> POST $SCANNER/triage 3) if threshold met -> POST $ESCALATE/webhook` Ensure audit write idempotent and include audit_id in PR comment.

maya: policy: ephemeral grants allowed only if evidence pointer exists AND human reviewer assigned. auto-escalation path cannot request decrypt by default.

oncall-sre: runbook must include commands to verify audit entries, example: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ME" https://audit.internal/events?pr=5301209876 | jq '.[0] | {id,actor,action,timestamp}'`

zoe: action items: 1) infra+maya: design kms-proxy + policy (ETA Fri) 2) pete+infra: GH Action + audit write + PR attestation (ETA Wed) 3) oncall-sre: digest format + runbook template (ETA Mon) 4) compliance: sample signed audit entry for sign-off (ETA Tue). I'll open ISSUE-SEC-518 and link here.

maya: adding note: when issuing tokens, proxy should mint non-exportable decrypt tokens and require key-version pinning.

zoe: thanks all :thumbsup:
